title: SimpleMute
body:
Prevent players from using chat, books and quills, signs, and other forms of comunications...

Made to be lightweight and simple to use.

To mute a player use the command: /mute Username Duration Reason

Commands and Permissions (Use LuckPerms):
| Command   | Permission          | Description             | Default |
|-----------|---------------------|-------------------------|---------|
| /mute     | simplemute.mute     | Mutes a Player          | OP      |
| /unmute   | simplemute.unmute   | Unmutes a Player        | OP      |
| /mutelist | simplemute.mutelist | Lists All Muted Players | OP      |
